div.head: Cn 1018 25
div.ab: And se ðe unlaga arære. oððe undom deme heonan forð. for læððe. oððe feohfange. beo se wið þone cyngc. cxx. scillinga scildig. buton he geladige. þæt he na bet ne cuðe.
And se ðe unlaga arære oððe undom deme heonan forð, for læððe oððe feohfange, beo se wið þone cyngc CXX scillinga scildig, buton he geladige þæt he na bet ne cuðe.
And from now on he who promotes injustice or makes unjust judgments, either from hate or for profit, shall forfeit 120 shillings to the king, unless he provides an oath that he knew no better.

And anyone henceforth who promotes injustice or hands down unjust judgments, either because of bias or bribery, shall be liable to the king for one hundred twenty shillings, unless he can declare under oath that he did not know how to deliver a more just sentence.
